hardware: RTX 3070 8 GB (SM 8.6), 64 GB DDR4, Windows 11; initial baselines on ComfyUI v0.36.0 / comfy-kitchen 0.2.34, re-verified on ComfyUI v0.37.4 / comfy-kitchen 0.2.35; PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130

model_geometry.latent: f16t4d24 (16x spatial, 4x temporal, 24 channels) with 1x2x2 patch merge = 32x spatial

sequence_960x544_124f.derivation: 2 * 33e9 params * 15810 tokens; excludes attention and embedding terms

measured_step_rate.note: phase-1 runs at 93.5-100% of the measured fused-GEMM ceiling; corrected from the earlier 63k-token figure (see docs/03 retraction 5)

c3_lightx2v_4step.adopted_as: fast path to 1080p at archive time
c3_lightx2v_4step.label: exploratory (N=1, single seed)

composite_anchor_variant.adopted_as: default identity-binding mechanism when a prior render of the scene exists
composite_anchor_variant.change: anchor + primary reference replaced by a frame extracted from a prior render (composite_f15); all else equal to ulta_larryvrh_6step
composite_anchor_variant.label: exploratory (N=1, single seed); adoption also rests on frame-level visual checks (wardrobe held across 124 frames)

chain_link_on_c3.change: link 2 anchors on link 1's literal last frame; C3 config unchanged
chain_link_on_c3.label: exploratory (N=1); seam is a single measured frame pair

h1_h2_544p_single_pass.adopted_as: context only (superseded by the two-phase paths above)
h1_h2_544p_single_pass.label: exploratory (N=1 each); the two runs are not a controlled A/B (different cache states)

pdd8_acceleration.verdict: banned from quality paths; kept only as an explicitly labeled draft tier

243f_1080p_refine.verdict: not viable on 8 GB; 10.13 s at true 1080p requires concatenation, last-frame chaining, post-upscale, or a larger card

768p_few_step_dispatch_collapse.verdict: few-step LoRA at non-native block dimensions collapses throughput; not used

step_16_profile.verdict: fails parity; the value profile is 25 steps

nvfp4.verdict: no native kernel path on SM 8.6; never used

notes: All wall times include submit-to-completion end to end (staging, encode, queue).
edge_proxy is a Laplacian edge-variance indicator, not perceptual quality; it is not comparable across resolutions and has no error bars here. See docs/03 retraction 4.
No configuration in this file was clock-locked. GPU power ran at 219-221 W against the 220 W board limit at 74-77 C.
The 124-frame audio stream in the output container is documented as 2x the video duration in the source lab; not fixed at archive time.

archive_run_id / lab_record_id identify immutable records in the non-redistributed laboratory archive (campaign-prefixed BENCH_YYYY-MM-DD_* ids; '+' joins multiple records; _sN is a section suffix). See docs/ARCHIVE_INDEX.md.
